name: bulk-image-resizer
description: Batch-resize local images to one exact pixel size in the browser (fit with transparent or white padding, or center-crop) and download a ZIP, for favicons, app icons, Open Graph images and product or avatar sets.

description_i18n.en: Batch-resize local images to one exact pixel size in the browser (fit with transparent or white padding, or center-crop) and download a ZIP, for favicons, app icons, Open Graph images and product or avatar sets.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 在浏览器中把一批本地图片批量缩放到同一精确像素尺寸（透明或白底留边适配，或居中裁剪），并打包下载 ZIP，适合网站图标、App 图标、Open Graph 分享图和商品图、头像组。
